question: P, R, T, V and W live on different floors of the same building. The lowermost floor in the building is numbered 1, the floor above it is numbered 2, and so on till the topmost floor is numbered 5. V lives on the floor immediately below W. P lives on the floor immediately above T. R lives on the floor immediately above P. W lives on the floor immediately below T. Who lives on the third floor?
solution:

1) V lives on the floor immediately below W.

2) W lives on the floor immediately below T.
